title: Noss
blurb: A free Mac app. Ask Claude or ChatGPT from whatever app you're in and the answer shows up right there, so you never switch tabs.

title: cu25
blurb: Book Cornell rooms on 25Live from your terminal, or let an AI agent do it. Already in use.

title: Zybit
blurb: Voice AI that writes a dentist's spoken findings straight into Open Dental, on the right tooth and in their own codes.

title: Reckon Review
blurb: A GitHub app that blocks a pull request from merging until a human can explain, in their own words, what the change actually does.

title: KrillBench
blurb: How do 11 AI models play the word game Krillion? 350 prompts, scored against the game's official answer sheets.

title: CommitMint
blurb: An app that helps you spend less time on screens. Everyone puts money in, and the people who hit their goal split it.
